job.job_description:
Required:
5+ years of experience in software development, Dev SecOps, or a security engineering role with a development component
Comfortable with at least one backend language (Python, Node.js, or similar) and familiar with REST APIs and JSON
Experience working with databases (SQL) reading, writing, and debugging queries
Ability to work productively with AI coding assistants you know when to trust the output and when to push back
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills able to trace an issue from symptom to root cause
Good written communication able to document what you build and explain it to non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working independently with limited supervision
Preferred:
Familiarity with the security tooling ecosystem EDR, SIEM/Data Analysis Platforms, Vulnerability Management platform, Cloud Security Platform, Ticketing systems etc.
Experience building or maintaining integrations between security platforms
Basic understanding of vulnerability management concepts (CVEs, severity, remediation work flows)
Exposure to Docker, Linux, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS)
Experience with React or a comparable frontend framework for internal tooling


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
